description: Frozen-physics 64x64 confirmation of the improving Stage 48 projected phi/psi mapped-polar spatial sequence
positive_findings: The 64x64 solution converged in 1550 iterations and remained finite and positive with wall-mass balance 2.051199878905107e-16.
Heat-flux error decreased from 5.679793259945467% at 56x56 to 5.323370002981724% at 64x64.
Table-3 relative RMS decreased from 0.42365149047170675 to 0.34777209032506057 while sign agreement remained 80%.
The 56x56-to-64x64 heat-flux and complete-profile changes were 0.33840851935676985% and 9.048553892280058%, satisfying the preregistered 3% and 10% cross-Knudsen thresholds.
negative_findings: The finite-grid Table-6 error remains 5.323370002981724%; the 64x64 result is not exact agreement with the published value.
The finite-grid Table-3 relative RMS remains 0.34777209032506057 and sign agreement remains only 80%.
Weighted positivity clipping persists at 0.3122144949217257% for phi and 0.5236378288354882% for psi.
The h-to-zero extrapolation is diagnostic only: it leaves 2.7481723939249515% heat-flux error and 0.2758967944737467 Table-3 relative RMS.
interpretation_guard: Stage 49 changed only physical-grid resolution. Knudsen number, temperatures, projected Shakhov model, Prandtl number, viscosity law, relaxation mapping, mapped-polar velocity rule, source relaxation, positivity floor, transport order, stopping criteria and observables remained frozen. The convergence screen permits a cross-Knudsen extension but does not itself establish external validation.
